scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
- I hear somebody talking - - remote communication -
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
- 听到有人在说话 - - 远程通讯 -

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I was asked to collect some kind of research charts...
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
我收到委托，要收集一些研究员记录表...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
[Ohno Tohiro]
My shoulders are heavy.
Our long-cherished wish..
One by one, slowly..
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
[大野 敏弘]
肩膀上的担子很重。
我们长久以来的愿望...
一点一点，慢慢实现...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Yes... everything is proceeding smoothly.
The status of the report collection is okay.
Yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
是的...一切进展顺利。
报告收集的情况良好。
是的，长官。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I'll immediately report the information related to the laboratory as a top priority.
Yes, sir...  I'll do so.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
我会立即将实验室相关的资讯作为最高优先级上报。
是的，长官...我会照做的。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Oh somebody has come! I'll call you again later.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
哦，有人来了！我稍后再联系你。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Uh...? I didn't realize someone is here already...
hmm... hmm...
Is there something you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
呃...？我没注意到你已经在这里了...
嗯...嗯...
你有什么事找我吗？

scripts.text: End the conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Ask him about the tomb of honor.
scripts.translation: 询问关于荣誉墓穴的事

scripts.text: Return to the tomb of honor.
scripts.translation: 返回荣誉墓穴

scripts.text: Say that Zeny is not enough.
scripts.translation: 表示Zeny不足

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
There are many adventurers looking for this crevice, except for you!
If you change your mind, come back to me again!
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
除了你之外，有很多冒险者都在寻找这个裂缝！
如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You also heard about the crevice that leads to that place, right?
There are many adventurers like you these days!
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
你也听说过通往那个地方的裂缝，对吧？
最近像你这样的冒险者可真多啊！

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I entered this crevice for the first time and guess what? It led to a place where there are so many monsters swarming around.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
我第一次进入这个裂缝，你猜怎么着？里面竟然挤满了魔物。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I gave a heads up to one adventurer I know. Then, he showed a high interest in it!
He kept muttering to himself about biomedical research, labs something like that.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
我提醒了一位认识的冒险者。然后，他表现出极大的兴趣！
他一直在自言自语，提到生物医学研究、实验室之类的东西。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
He kept asking me to show him how to get there. I felt reluctant to let him know about this crevice because I didn't want others to know about it. But I traded this info for 100,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
他不断要求我告诉他怎么到达那里。我本来不想让别人知道这个裂缝，但最终还是以100,000 Zeny的价格卖给了他。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Not much later, he came back with his body thoroughly injured. It was a miracle that he came back alive... It was horrible...
However, he was holding several items. At first glance, they looked so powerful that even I felt scared.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
没过多久，他浑身是伤地回来了。他能活着回来真是个奇迹...太可怕了...
不过，他手里拿着几件物品。乍一看，那些东西强大得连我都感到害怕。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
After that, many adventurers entered this dangerous place through this crevice after hearing the rumor. I hardly found any adventurers coming out of this crevice again. Since then, this place has been called the tomb of honor.
I earned some money thanks to them, though.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
之后，许多冒险者听到传闻，纷纷通过这条裂缝进入这个危险的地方。我几乎没再看到有冒险者从裂缝里出来。从那以后，这个地方就被称为荣誉墓穴。
不过，我靠他们赚了不少钱。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You want to know why I earned money?
I found this place for the first time, so its ownership belongs to me as well! You got a problem with that?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
你想知道我为什么能赚钱吗？
我是第一个发现这个地方的人，所以所有权也归我！你有意见吗？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Hmm hmm... Anyway, give me 100,000 Zeny. Then, I'll open the door which leads to the crevice for adventurers like you...
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
嗯嗯...总之，给我100,000 Zeny。然后，我会为像你这样的冒险者打开通往裂缝的门...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You don't have enough money!
There is nothing free in this world!
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
你的钱不够！
这个世界上没有免费的东西！

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Let me see... one... two... three
Alright. Now that I received the Zeny, I'll open the crevice.
I hope you can come back alive!...
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
让我看看...一...二...三。
好的。既然收到了Zeny，我就打开裂缝。
希望你能活着回来！...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
What? You don't have enough Zeny, but you want to enter?
Hmm... Then... by any chance, you have a research chart?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
什么？你Zeny不够，但还想进去？
嗯...那么...碰巧的话，你有研究员记录表吗？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Hush, speak quietly. People around here may hear us. Do you have it or not?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
嘘，小声点。周围的人可能会听到。你到底有没有？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Don't ask me why I need it. Just bring me 10 research charts. Then, I'll send you to the tomb of honor for nothing. What you do think?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
别问我为什么需要它。只要给我10张研究员记录表。然后，我就免费送你进入荣誉墓穴。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Go back to the previous menu.
scripts.translation: 返回上一级菜单

scripts.text: Hand over 10 research charts.
scripts.translation: 交出10张研究员记录表

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
You got any other business with me?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
你还有别的事找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
It seems 10 research charts are missing now.
Maybe you didn't pick them up from the warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
看来现在少了10张研究员记录表。
也许你没有从仓库里取出来。

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Is there something else you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
还有别的事要我帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
Oh... yes, this is it... This is what I need... hoo hoo...
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
哦...是的，就是这个...这正是我需要的...呼...呼...

scripts.text:
[Ohno Tohiro]
I'll send you to the crevice as promised.
I want you alive. See you again!
scripts.translation:
[大野 敏弘]
我会按约定把你送到裂缝。
我要你活着。再见！

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
What are you looking for? Are you looking for the place where all the dead men roam?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你在找什么？是在找那些亡魂游荡的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I can take you there if you want. You will need ^0000cd20 Sentimental Fragment and 150K Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
如果你愿意，我可以带你去。你需要^0000cd20邪念碎片和150,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Or you can just see sentiment safely without the interruption of the dead. That will cost you ^0000cd30 Sentimental Fragment and 2M Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
或者你可以安全地观察思念，而不受亡魂的打扰。这需要^0000cd30邪念碎片和2,000,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你想去哪里？

scripts.text: Where all the dead men roam.
scripts.translation: 亡魂游荡的地方

scripts.text: Only thoughts can be met.
scripts.translation: 只能遇见思念

scripts.text: What kind of place is it?
scripts.translation: 那是什么样的地方？

scripts.text: I don't mind.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
You have everything right?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你带齐所有东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
It's not enough. You need ^0000cd20 Sentimental Fragment and 150K Zeny^000000. I can't take you there for free.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
不够。你需要^0000cd20邪念碎片和150K Zeny^000000。我不能免费带你去。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
You have everything right?
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你带齐所有东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Good. You have everything. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
很好。你带齐了所有东西。我带你去。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
But... I'm taking you there for money... you should be careful.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
不过...我是为了钱才带你去的...你要小心。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
So.. if you go inside, you'll see a ^0000cdStrange Machine that looks like a crystal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
所以...如果你进去，会看到一台^0000cd看起来像水晶的奇怪机器^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
This machine will recover your HP if you use it. It helped me survive. I have no idea why it's in that kind of place though...
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
使用这台机器可以恢复你的HP。它曾帮我活了下来。不过我不知道它为什么会在那种地方...

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I turned off the machine so no one can use it, but I'll let you use it as my special treat.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我关掉了机器，不让别人使用，但我会让你使用，作为我的特别优待。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Please be careful and use the machine if you need to!!
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
请小心，如果需要的话就使用机器！！

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
You've got all the items and money??
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
你带齐了所有物品和钱吗？

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
It's not enough. ^0000cd30 Sentimental Fragment and 2M Zeny^000000 are needed. I can't take you for free.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
不够。需要^0000cd30邪念碎片和2M Zeny^000000。我不能免费带你去。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Good. You have everything. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
很好。你带齐了所有东西。我带你去。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
The exit is outside of the wall.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
出口在墙外。

scripts.output:
[露娜]
^EE0000嗯，我也有一件事要提醒。在那里无法保存位置，所以如果你下线或断线，会被传送到存档点。^000000
scripts.text:
[Lunar]
^EE0000Well, I also have a warning. Your location can't be saved in there, so if you log off or get disconnected, you'll be moved to your save point.

[Lunar]
I dug in the ground to find something to eat and I found something even better.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我挖地找吃的，结果发现了更好的东西。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
The living can't survive there. Only the dead roam around.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
活人无法在那里生存。只有死人在那里徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
There's a rumor.. that people who went there never came back...
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
有个传闻...说去过那里的人再也没有回来...

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I was so scared but.. it became clear that it's a popular place for adventurers to visit.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我很害怕，但...后来发现那里是冒险者常去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
The place I arrived at was ^0000cdnear Strange Sentiment^000000.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
我到达的地方是^0000cd靠近奇怪情感^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I ran away since so many dead men tried to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
因为很多死人试图杀我，所以我逃跑了。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
But then I got lost and fell down to a weird place.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
然后我迷路了，掉进了一个奇怪的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
The place was the same as where the dead men roam ^0000cdbut there are only sentiments^000000. I was so scared, so I got out right away.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
那个地方和死人在那里徘徊的地方一样^0000cd但那里只有情感^000000。我很害怕，所以立刻逃了出来。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
I will take you there if you give me the money and items.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
如果你给我钱和物品，我就带你去那里。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
You might go easier without his help.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
没有他的帮助，你可能会更容易一些。

scripts.text:
[Lunar]
Please visit me any time. We have nothing to lose anyway.
scripts.translation:
[露娜]
请随时来找我。反正我们也输不起。

scripts.text: Don't exit the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 不离开迷宫

scripts.text: Exit the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 离开迷宫

scripts.text: - You still have business to deal with here -
scripts.translation: - 你在这里还有事要处理 -

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Oh! You want to exchange mind or grudge pieces?
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
哦！你想交换心智或怨恨碎片吗？

scripts.text: Listen to the story.
scripts.translation: 听故事

scripts.text: {0}1 Will of Warrior (200 Energy pieces)
scripts.translation: {0}1 勇士的意志 (200 能量碎片)

scripts.text: {0}1 Blood Thirst (200 energy pieces)
scripts.translation: {0}1 血的饥渴 (200 能量碎片)

scripts.text: {0}1 Ghost Chill (300 energy pieces)^000000

[Veteran Adventurer]
You look like you have free time, don't you? Well, my business is slow these days too...
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
你看起来挺闲的，不是吗？嗯，我最近生意也很冷清...

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
One day, the guild master entered in my guild all of a sudden...
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
有一天，公会会长突然闯进了我的公会...

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
'^1F294DI'll make all members in all guilds wear the Cloak of the Fallen Soldier!!^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
'^1F294D我要让所有公会的成员都穿上堕落士兵的斗篷！！^000000'

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
As you know, this equipment requires a large amount of material, so all guild members had no choice but to be stuck in the dungeon and forced to work.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
你知道的，这件装备需要大量的材料，所以所有公会成员别无选择，只能被困在迷宫里被迫工作。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
You never know what luck you eventually may have. I flung myself into this digging work with determination and found so many rare pieces.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
你永远不知道最终会有什么运气。我怀着坚定的决心投入这项挖掘工作，结果发现了许多稀有碎片。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Ms. Sub-guild master sent me to exchange things with others as a pile kept forming.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
副会长女士派我去和别人交换东西，因为碎片堆积如山。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Of course, the amount of exchange was decided by the guild master emphasizing
'^1F294DI'll never accept it if it's below this amount!!^000000'...
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
当然，交换的数量是由会长强调'^1F294D如果低于这个数量我绝不接受！！^000000'来决定的...

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Ms. Sub-guild master tried to throw dirt into the guild master's eyes. We really had a hard time stopping her.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
副会长女士试图往会长眼里撒土。我们真的很难阻止她。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
I guess we can take care of it quickly if he adjusts it to a low amount. (sigh)... That's what happened.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
我想如果我们把它调整到一个较低的数量，就可以很快处理掉。（叹气）...事情就是这样发生的。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
^3300661 {0}^000000 is exchanged with ^CC3333{1} Energy Pieces^000000.
Exchange.
scripts.translation: 兑换

scripts.text: Do not exchange.
scripts.translation: 不交换

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
What?... I thought you were going to exchange it.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
什么？...我以为你要兑换它。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Sorry. I don't have a choice because the guild master ordered it. You need {0} items, if he says no, I'm not at liberty to exchange it.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
抱歉。我没有选择，因为公会会长下令了。你需要{0}个物品，如果他说不行，我就没有权限进行兑换。

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Would you like to continue to exchange it?
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
您想继续兑换吗？

scripts.text: Continue with the exchange.
scripts.translation: 继续兑换

scripts.text: Stop the exchange.
scripts.translation: 停止兑换

scripts.text:
[Veteran Adventurer]
Thank you... I guess I won't be punished by the guild master, thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[资深冒险者]
谢谢...多亏了你，我想我不会被公会会长惩罚了。

scripts.text:
[Bully]
Hey, buddy. Do you have some remaining Energy pieces? I'll exchange them with something appropriate if you want.
scripts.translation:
[恶霸]
嘿，伙计。你还有多余的<死亡骑士>能量碎片吗？如果你想的话，我可以拿合适的东西跟你换。

scripts.text: Listen to the story.
scripts.translation: 听故事

scripts.text: {0}1 Energy Fragment (2000 Silent E Particles)
scripts.translation: {0}1 能量碎片 (2000 寂静E粒子)

scripts.text: {0}1 Energy Fragment (1000 Weak E Particles)
scripts.translation: {0}1 能量碎片 (1000 微弱E粒子)

scripts.text: {0}1 Energy Fragment (500 Unstable E Particles)
scripts.translation: {0}1 能量碎片 (500 不稳定E粒子)

scripts.text: {0}1 Energy Fragment (500 Sinister E Particles)
scripts.translation: {0}1 能量碎片 (500 邪恶E粒子)

scripts.text: {0}1 Energy Fragment (50 Fallen E Particles)
scripts.translation: {0}1 能量碎片 (50 堕落E粒子)

scripts.text: {0}1 Sentimental Fragment (50 Energy Fragments)
scripts.translation: {0}1 邪念碎片 (50 能量碎片)

scripts.text: {0}1 Cursed Fragment (666 Energy Fragments)
scripts.translation: {0}1 怨念碎片 (666 能量碎片)

scripts.text:
[Bully]
Hmm... this is quite unexpected.
Normally he ignores me and goes on to do his work.
scripts.translation:
[恶霸]
嗯...这有点出乎意料。
通常他会无视我，然后继续做他的工作。

scripts.text:
[Bully]
I'm sorry, but I've got nothing to say. I'm just doing this because I can earn lots of money.
scripts.translation:
[恶霸]
抱歉，我没什么好说的。我做这些只是为了能赚很多钱。

scripts.text:
[Bully]
Are you sure you want to exchange ^330066{0} {1}^000000 with ^CC33331 {2}^000000?
Exchange.
scripts.translation: 兑换

scripts.text: Do not exchange.
scripts.translation: 不交换

scripts.text:
[Bully]
Well... if you don't like it, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[恶霸]
好吧...如果你不喜欢的，那就算了。

scripts.text:
[Bully]
No... No... you shouldn't do this.
You told me you would exchange it with {0} (item)s.
scripts.translation:
[恶霸]
不...不...你不应该这样。
你说过要用{0}个物品来兑换的。

scripts.text:
[Bully]
Oh thank you. Is there something else you want to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[恶霸]
哦，谢谢。还有其他想兑换的吗？

scripts.text: Continue with the exchange.
scripts.translation: 继续兑换

scripts.text: Stop the exchange.
